fable-ultra-example-local.comment: SAMPLE ONLY — replace with real servers you need. stdio pattern works on Windows/macOS/Linux; point the last arg at YOUR project root (Windows example: J:\fable 5, POSIX example: /home/user/projects, portable default: .).

_connector_notes.how_to_add: Register servers with `claude mcp add <name> -- <command>` or edit this file. claude.ai connectors (GitHub, Notion, Slack, LSEG, Daloopa, Figma, Zapier, etc.) are authorized in claude.ai connector settings, or via /mcp in an interactive claude session.
_connector_notes.discovery: Discover from inside a session with the harness tools: ListConnectors (what is already wired), SuggestConnectors (recommendations for the current task), SearchMcpRegistry (search the public MCP registry). Deferred tool schemas load on demand via ToolSearch — a tool listed by name only must be loaded with ToolSearch before it can be called.
_connector_notes.remote_sessions: Remote/web sessions run in ephemeral Linux containers with no gh CLI — GitHub goes through the GitHub MCP server tools (mcp__github__*). Playwright/Chromium is pre-installed (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers) for browser-driven verification without any install step.
_connector_notes.zapier_flow: Zapier MCP is skills-first: list_zapier_skills / get_zapier_skill for saved workflows, then discover_zapier_actions -> enable_zapier_action -> execute_zapier_read_action / execute_zapier_write_action; write_code_action for custom logic. Call list_enabled_zapier_actions before executing.

other providers only via a connected API key/MCP

android-app: figma (optional, design handoff: get_design_context/get_screenshot; use_figma writes require the /figma-use skill first)
trading-bot: market data: LSEG plugin or broker MCP or public APIs via WebFetch
astrology-report: none required; WebFetch for geocoding, zapier optional for delivery
ai-builder: none required; claude-api skill for model ids/pricing
exa/web search optional for eval data
vision-ocr: none required; local tesseract/pdfplumber installs documented in the skill
algorithm-factory: none required; language-native timers for benchmarks
qs-works: none required; python+openpyxl documented in the skill
workflow-factory: none required; Workflow tool (built-in), node for syntax gates
knowledge-lake: none required; WebFetch/exa for source verification; github MCP optional for durable persistence
dream-factory: inherits the connectors of whichever domain skills it drives

_connector_notes.rule: If a skill's required connector is not connected/authorized, the skill STOPS and reports the setup steps. Connector output is never simulated.
